title: How Your Phone Secretly *Hears* Your Fingerprint 🤔 #shorts
description:
Your phone screen just scanned your finger — but there's no camera where you touched it. Here's the hidden tech underneath.
💡 Older phones flash light and photograph your ridges
🔊 Newer phones fire silent sound pulses instead
🌊 Ridges and valleys bounce that sound back at different speeds
🧩 That timing difference builds a full 3D map of your print
💧 It even works through water, oil, and thick glass
Subscribe for more tech explainers that show you what's really happening inside your devices.
